scope: Documentary source definitions only; not native asset, timing, historical contract epoch or live admission qualification.

paraphrase.vol: Contract-count volume; both transaction sides are included.
paraphrase.amount: Coin quantity, defined in the Chinese USDT-M document as contract count multiplied by contract face value. The English amount formula appears inconsistent, so do not infer inverse conversion from it.
paraphrase.trade_turnover: Sum of each trade quantity in contracts times contract face value and traded price. Quote currency needs exact instrument identity. Do not silently halve the native field.
paraphrase.count: Number of trades, described as including both sides.
paraphrase.clocks: Bar id is its start timestamp; response ts is milliseconds. Original body completion/knowledge and exact calendar still need their own evidence.

saved_data_progress.new31_case_result: Source worker qualification only; not repeated by coordinator
